value.definition: a name format joining words with nothing between, every word but the first starting capital

invariants.statement: A capital opens a word and a word may be one letter.
Whether an acronym is one word or many words cannot be read off the name.

value.definition: a name format joining words with hyphens, all letters lower

invariants.statement: A digit sits inside a word rather than between words.

value.definition: a name format joining words with underscores, all letters lower
a name format joining hex groups with hyphens, all letters lower

invariants.statement: The one shape a uuid is written in is 8-4-4-4-12 hex digits.
Which version or variant a uuid has is not judged here.
`id-is-a-uuid-version-7` judges which version or variant a uuid has.

value.definition: a name format separating words with spaces, capitalized as a sentence is

invariants.statement: Only the opening capital and the single spaces parting the words are judged.
A proper noun cannot be told from the name.

value.definition: a name format separating words with spaces, every word starting capital

invariants.statement: A name has no word opening lower.
A lower word between the first and the last is refused here.
A lower word between the first and the last is let through by title case.
A name padded or doubly spaced is not written in start case.

value.definition: a name format separating words with spaces, every important word starting capital

invariants.statement: The first word and the last are taken as important.
Which word between the first and the last is important cannot be read off the name.
A lower word between the first and the last is let through.
A name padded or doubly spaced is not written in title case.

value.definition: a name format joining words with nothing between, every word starting capital

invariants.statement: A capital opens a word and a word may be one letter.
Whether an acronym is one word or many words cannot be read off the name.

value.definition: a name format joining words with underscores, all letters capital
a name format joining hex groups with hyphens, all letters capital

invariants.statement: The one shape a uuid is written in is 8-4-4-4-12 hex digits.
Nothing here is written in upper uuid.
A uuid is written in lower uuid.
